partition: Six/two/two complete flight repetitions per condition; never split overlapping windows across roles. The tasks share the same 120 healthy controls.

training_window_selection.selection: All eligible fault endpoints; deterministic evenly spaced eligible healthy endpoints when above the cap. A healthy fitting history must be healthy throughout.
training_window_selection.labels: Binary bounded-event health; intermittent nominal gaps remain inside the labelled intervention; recovery excluded from fault supervision.

alarm.fresh_run_start: At or after onset; confirmation strictly before actual event end

metric_scope.joint_isolation: Correct unique motor at the first fresh confirmed event alarm / all faulty flights. A later correct prediction does not repair a wrong first alarm.
metric_scope.false_alarms: 60 times healthy confirmed transitions divided by eligible healthy exposure in seconds; pooled dedicated controls and pre-fault baseline.
metric_scope.delay: Conditional median onset-to-confirmation on detected flights, including wrong-motor alarms, then mean across runs. Excludes processing/communication.
metric_scope.coverage: Censoring and incomplete observations remain explicit; non-detection does not always mean a fully observed miss.
metric_scope.uncertainty: Sample SD across training seeds on fixed physical test flights, not independent partition uncertainty.

development_scope: Earlier results on held-out repetitions informed method development; evaluation is retrospective.
data_availability: Data and fitted checkpoints are not bundled in this private research repository.
